# Lore Organics

> Premium organic period care. GOTS certified organic cotton pads, tampons and liners. Launching soon in the Netherlands and Germany.

Lore Organics designs plastic-free, GOTS certified organic cotton period care for women with high standards. We donate 1% of every sale to women's shelters and period poverty organisations from day one.

## Pages

- [Home](/): The range, how the Cycle Box works, materials and founders.
- [Products](/products): Organic cotton pads, tampons and liners with full material transparency.
- [Cycle Box](/cycle-box): Build your own subscription box, delivered every 2, 3 or 6 months; save up to 10%.
- [About](/about): Our mission, founders and design philosophy.
- [Materials](/materials): Every material in our pads and tampons, certification and testing.
- [Giving](/giving): 1% of everything we sell goes to Armoedefonds as donated product.
- [The Lore](/the-lore): The Lore of LORE, our short video series.
